summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine open-market share buyback. On 15 May 2026, it purchased 30,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 94.0888 pence per share (range 93.3000-95.0000 pence). Shares will be cancelled. The purchases are part of an existing buyback program announced on 30 January 2026. This is an issuer repurchase, not a special-situation tender offer or capital-return event. No change of control, delisting, or premium is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure under UK Market Abuse Regulation.
